title: Die neue Arbeitswelt — The New World of Work
summary: Home office, flexible hours and digital tools are changing how people in Germany work — with new chances and new risks.
summary_en: Home office, flexible hours and digital tools are changing how people in Germany work — with new chances and new risks.
summary_id: Kantor dari rumah, jam kerja fleksibel, dan peralatan digital mengubah cara orang Jerman bekerja — dengan peluang dan risiko baru.

paragraphs.text: Immer mehr Unternehmen in Deutschland bieten ihren Mitarbeitenden Homeoffice an. Viele Menschen schätzen die flexible Zeiteinteilung, weil sie Familie und Beruf besser vereinbaren können.
paragraphs.translation: More and more companies in Germany offer their employees home office. Many people appreciate flexible scheduling because they can balance family and work better.
paragraphs.translation_en: More and more companies in Germany offer their employees home office. Many people appreciate flexible scheduling because they can balance family and work better.
paragraphs.translation_id: Semakin banyak perusahaan di Jerman menawarkan kerja dari rumah. Banyak orang menyukai pengaturan waktu yang fleksibel karena lebih mudah menyeimbangkan keluarga dan pekerjaan.

paragraphs.text: Zugleich fühlen sich einige Beschäftigte isoliert. Fehlt der direkte Austausch mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen, entstehen Missverständnisse schneller. Deshalb planen viele Firmen feste Tage im Büro.
paragraphs.translation: At the same time some employees feel isolated. When direct exchange with colleagues is missing, misunderstandings occur faster. That is why many companies plan fixed days in the office.
paragraphs.translation_en: At the same time some employees feel isolated. When direct exchange with colleagues is missing, misunderstandings occur faster. That is why many companies plan fixed days in the office.
paragraphs.translation_id: Di sisi lain, sebagian karyawan merasa terisolasi. Tanpa pertukaran langsung dengan rekan kerja, kesalahpahaman lebih cepat terjadi. Karena itu banyak perusahaan merencanakan hari kerja tetap di kantor.

paragraphs.text: Experten sind sich einig: Die digitale Arbeitswelt braucht klare Regeln und regelmäßige Gespräche, damit alle profitieren. Kommunikation bleibt der Schlüssel zum Erfolg.
paragraphs.translation: Experts agree: The digital world of work needs clear rules and regular conversations so that everyone benefits. Communication remains the key to success.
paragraphs.translation_en: Experts agree: The digital world of work needs clear rules and regular conversations so that everyone benefits. Communication remains the key to success.
paragraphs.translation_id: Para ahli sepakat: dunia kerja digital membutuhkan aturan yang jelas dan komunikasi rutin agar semua diuntungkan. Komunikasi tetap menjadi kunci keberhasilan.

title: Klimaschutz im Alltag — Climate Protection in Daily Life
summary: Many Germans want to protect the climate, but real change needs more than individual action — politics, economy and society must work together.
summary_en: Many Germans want to protect the climate, but real change needs more than individual action — politics, economy and society must work together.
summary_id: Banyak orang Jerman ingin melindungi iklim, tetapi perubahan nyata membutuhkan lebih dari aksi individu — politik, ekonomi, dan masyarakat harus bekerja sama.

paragraphs.text: Nora versucht, bewusst zu leben: Sie kauft regionale Produkte, fährt Rad zur Arbeit und sortiert ihren Müll. Trotzdem fragt sie sich manchmal, ob ihre kleinen Schritte wirklich etwas verändern.
paragraphs.translation: Nora tries to live consciously: She buys regional products, cycles to work and sorts her waste. Still she sometimes wonders whether her small steps really change anything.
paragraphs.translation_en: Nora tries to live consciously: She buys regional products, cycles to work and sorts her waste. Still she sometimes wonders whether her small steps really change anything.
paragraphs.translation_id: Nora berusaha hidup sadar lingkungan: membeli produk lokal, naik sepeda ke tempat kerja, dan memilah sampah. Namun kadang ia bertanya-tanya apakah langkah kecilnya benar-benar mengubah sesuatu.

paragraphs.text: Wissenschaftler betonen, dass der Einzelne nicht allein verantwortlich ist. Politische Entscheidungen wie strengere Vorschriften und Investitionen in erneuerbare Energien sind ebenso wichtig.
paragraphs.translation: Scientists emphasize that the individual is not solely responsible. Political decisions such as stricter regulations and investments in renewable energy are just as important.
paragraphs.translation_en: Scientists emphasize that the individual is not solely responsible. Political decisions such as stricter regulations and investments in renewable energy are just as important.
paragraphs.translation_id: Para ilmuwan menegaskan bahwa individu tidak bertanggung jawab sendiri. Keputusan politik seperti peraturan yang lebih ketat dan investasi energi terbarukan sama pentingnya.

paragraphs.text: In vielen Städten entstehen deshalb neue Ideen: Mehr Fahrradwege, günstige Nahverkehrstickets und Nachhaltigkeit in der Stadtplanung. So wird Umweltschutz für alle spürbar.
paragraphs.translation: That is why new ideas are emerging in many cities: more bike lanes, cheap public transport tickets and sustainability in urban planning. In this way environmental protection becomes noticeable for everyone.
paragraphs.translation_en: That is why new ideas are emerging in many cities: more bike lanes, cheap public transport tickets and sustainability in urban planning. In this way environmental protection becomes noticeable for everyone.
paragraphs.translation_id: Karena itu banyak kota memunculkan ide baru: lebih banyak jalur sepeda, tiket angkutan umum murah, dan keberlanjutan dalam perencanaan kota. Dengan begitu perlindungan lingkungan terasa bagi semua orang.

paragraphs.text: Für Nora ist klar: Umdenken beginnt im Alltag, doch echte Veränderung gelingt nur gemeinsam. Sie bleibt optimistisch, weil immer mehr Menschen sich engagieren.
paragraphs.translation: For Nora it is clear: a change of mindset begins in everyday life, but real change only succeeds together. She stays optimistic because more and more people get involved.
paragraphs.translation_en: For Nora it is clear: a change of mindset begins in everyday life, but real change only succeeds together. She stays optimistic because more and more people get involved.
paragraphs.translation_id: Bagi Nora jelas: perubahan pola pikir dimulai dari keseharian, tetapi perubahan nyata hanya berhasil bersama-sama. Ia tetap optimis karena semakin banyak orang yang terlibat.

title: Wohnen in der Stadt — Living in the City
summary: Housing in big German cities is getting more expensive. Many people move to the outskirts or share flats to find affordable homes.
summary_en: Housing in big German cities is getting more expensive. Many people move to the outskirts or share flats to find affordable homes.
summary_id: Perumahan di kota-kota besar Jerman semakin mahal. Banyak orang pindah ke pinggiran atau berbagi apartemen untuk mencari hunian terjangkau.

paragraphs.text: Die Mieten in deutschen Großstädten steigen seit Jahren. Besonders junge Menschen haben es schwer, eine bezahlbare Wohnung zu finden. Ein Zimmer zu mieten ist oft die einzige Möglichkeit.
paragraphs.translation: Rents in large German cities have been rising for years. Especially young people find it hard to find an affordable flat. Renting a room is often the only option.
paragraphs.translation_en: Rents in large German cities have been rising for years. Especially young people find it hard to find an affordable flat. Renting a room is often the only option.
paragraphs.translation_id: Sewa di kota-kota besar Jerman terus naik selama bertahun-tahun. Terutama anak muda sulit menemukan apartemen terjangkau. Menyewa kamar sering menjadi satu-satunya pilihan.

paragraphs.text: Eine Alternative ist das Leben am Stadtrand. Dort sind die Mieten niedriger, aber die Wege zur Arbeit länger. Viele Berufspendler nehmen dafür lange Fahrzeiten mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln in Kauf.
paragraphs.translation: An alternative is living on the outskirts. Rents are lower there, but the commute to work is longer. Many commuters accept long travel times by public transport for that.
paragraphs.translation_en: An alternative is living on the outskirts. Rents are lower there, but the commute to work is longer. Many commuters accept long travel times by public transport for that.
paragraphs.translation_id: Alternatifnya adalah tinggal di pinggiran kota. Sewanya lebih rendah, tetapi perjalanan ke tempat kerja lebih panjang. Banyak pekerja rela menempuh perjalanan panjang dengan transportasi umum.

paragraphs.text: Auch Wohngemeinschaften werden beliebter. Wer bereit ist zu teilen, spart nicht nur Geld, sondern lernt auch neue Menschen kennen. So entsteht oft eine eigene Gemeinschaft.
paragraphs.translation: Shared flats are also becoming more popular. Whoever is willing to share saves not only money but also gets to know new people. In this way a community of its own often develops.
paragraphs.translation_en: Shared flats are also becoming more popular. Whoever is willing to share saves not only money but also gets to know new people. In this way a community of its own often develops.
paragraphs.translation_id: Hunian bersama juga semakin populer. Siapa yang mau berbagi tidak hanya menghemat uang, tetapi juga mengenal orang baru. Sering terbentuk komunitas tersendiri.

paragraphs.text: Die Wohnungsnot bleibt ein großes Thema. Politiker diskutieren über sozialen Wohnungsbau, während Bürger auf bezahlbare Angebote hoffen. Eine schnelle Lösung gibt es leider nicht.
paragraphs.translation: The housing shortage remains a big issue. Politicians discuss social housing construction while citizens hope for affordable offers. Unfortunately there is no quick solution.
paragraphs.translation_en: The housing shortage remains a big issue. Politicians discuss social housing construction while citizens hope for affordable offers. Unfortunately there is no quick solution.
paragraphs.translation_id: Krisis perumahan tetap menjadi isu besar. Para politisi berdiskusi tentang pembangunan perumahan sosial, sementara warga berharap ada tawaran terjangkau. Sayangnya belum ada solusi cepat.

title: Die richtige Berufswahl — Choosing the Right Career
summary: Choosing a career is one of the most important decisions in life. Good advice and self-reflection help young people find their path.
summary_en: Choosing a career is one of the most important decisions in life. Good advice and self-reflection help young people find their path.
summary_id: Memilih karier adalah salah satu keputusan terpenting dalam hidup. Nasihat yang baik dan refleksi diri membantu anak muda menemukan jalannya.

paragraphs.text: Nach der Schule stehen viele junge Menschen vor einer wichtigen Frage: Ausbildung oder Studium? Die Wahl ist nicht leicht, denn sie beeinflusst das ganze weitere Leben.
paragraphs.translation: After school many young people face an important question: apprenticeship or university? The choice is not easy because it influences the whole rest of life.
paragraphs.translation_en: After school many young people face an important question: apprenticeship or university? The choice is not easy because it influences the whole rest of life.
paragraphs.translation_id: Setelah sekolah, banyak anak muda menghadapi pertanyaan penting: magang atau kuliah? Pilihan itu tidak mudah karena memengaruhi seluruh kehidupan selanjutnya.

paragraphs.text: Experten empfehlen, nicht nur auf das Gehalt zu achten. Wichtiger sind eigene Interessen und Stärken. Wer seine Talente kennt, findet später leichter Zufriedenheit im Beruf.
paragraphs.translation: Experts advise not only paying attention to the salary. More important are one's own interests and strengths. Whoever knows their talents finds satisfaction in work more easily later.
paragraphs.translation_en: Experts advise not only paying attention to the salary. More important are one's own interests and strengths. Whoever knows their talents finds satisfaction in work more easily later.
paragraphs.translation_id: Para ahli menyarankan untuk tidak hanya memperhatikan gaji. Yang lebih penting adalah minat dan kekuatan diri sendiri. Siapa yang mengenal bakatnya akan lebih mudah menemukan kepuasan kerja.

paragraphs.text: Praktika und Beratungsangebote helfen bei der Entscheidung. Dabei lernen die Jugendlichen echte Arbeitsabläufe kennen und können ihre Vorstellungen überprüfen.
paragraphs.translation: Internships and advisory services help with the decision. In doing so young people get to know real work processes and can test their ideas.
paragraphs.translation_en: Internships and advisory services help with the decision. In doing so young people get to know real work processes and can test their ideas.
paragraphs.translation_id: Magang dan layanan konseling membantu pengambilan keputusan. Dengan itu para remaja mengenal proses kerja nyata dan dapat menguji gambaran mereka.

paragraphs.text: Letztlich gibt es keine perfekte Lösung. Wichtig ist, offen zu bleiben und Chancen zu nutzen. Denn der Berufsweg muss nicht gerade verlaufen, er darf auch Kurven nehmen.
paragraphs.translation: Ultimately there is no perfect solution. What matters is staying open and seizing opportunities. Because the career path does not have to be straight, it may also take curves.
paragraphs.translation_en: Ultimately there is no perfect solution. What matters is staying open and seizing opportunities. Because the career path does not have to be straight, it may also take curves.
paragraphs.translation_id: Pada akhirnya tidak ada solusi sempurna. Yang penting tetap terbuka dan memanfaatkan peluang. Karena jalan karier tidak harus lurus, boleh juga berkelok.

title: Reisen ohne Grenzen — Traveling without Borders
summary: Traveling opens minds and hearts. Intercultural experiences teach tolerance and make us see our own culture more clearly.
summary_en: Traveling opens minds and hearts. Intercultural experiences teach tolerance and make us see our own culture more clearly.
summary_id: Bepergian membuka pikiran dan hati. Pengalaman antarbudaya mengajarkan toleransi dan membuat kita melihat budaya sendiri dengan lebih jelas.

paragraphs.text: Für Jonas war die Auslandsreise nach Spanien ein Wendepunkt. Zum ersten Mal lebte er drei Monate in einem fremden Land und lernte Menschen mit anderen Gewohnheiten kennen.
paragraphs.translation: For Jonas the trip abroad to Spain was a turning point. For the first time he lived three months in a foreign country and got to know people with other habits.
paragraphs.translation_en: For Jonas the trip abroad to Spain was a turning point. For the first time he lived three months in a foreign country and got to know people with other habits.
paragraphs.translation_id: Bagi Jonas, perjalanan ke luar negeri ke Spanyol adalah titik balik. Untuk pertama kalinya ia tinggal tiga bulan di negara asing dan mengenal orang dengan kebiasaan berbeda.

paragraphs.text: Am Anfang war alles ungewohnt: das Essen, die Sprache und die Tageszeiten. Doch je länger er blieb, desto mehr verstand er die Kultur des Landes. Er lernte, Unterschiede nicht als Fehler zu sehen.
paragraphs.translation: At the beginning everything was unfamiliar: the food, the language and the daily rhythm. But the longer he stayed, the more he understood the country's culture. He learned not to see differences as mistakes.
paragraphs.translation_en: At the beginning everything was unfamiliar: the food, the language and the daily rhythm. But the longer he stayed, the more he understood the country's culture. He learned not to see differences as mistakes.
paragraphs.translation_id: Pada awalnya semuanya terasa asing: makanan, bahasa, dan ritme harian. Tetapi semakin lama ia tinggal, semakin ia memahami budaya negara itu. Ia belajar untuk tidak menganggap perbedaan sebagai kesalahan.

paragraphs.text: Zurück zu Hause betrachtet Jonas sein eigenes Land mit neuen Augen. Viele Selbstverständlichkeiten sind plötzlich nicht mehr selbstverständlich. Diese Erfahrung möchte er weitergeben.
paragraphs.translation: Back home Jonas looks at his own country with new eyes. Many obvious things suddenly no longer seem self-evident. He would like to pass on this experience.
paragraphs.translation_en: Back home Jonas looks at his own country with new eyes. Many obvious things suddenly no longer seem self-evident. He would like to pass on this experience.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kembali ke rumah, Jonas memandang negaranya sendiri dengan mata baru. Banyak hal yang biasa saja tiba-tiba tidak lagi terasa biasa. Pengalaman ini ingin ia teruskan kepada orang lain.

paragraphs.text: Wer reist, wird offener für die Welt. Interkulturelle Kompetenz ist heute nicht nur privat wertvoll, sondern auch in vielen Berufen gefragt.
paragraphs.translation: Whoever travels becomes more open to the world. Intercultural competence is today not only valuable privately but also in demand in many professions.
paragraphs.translation_en: Whoever travels becomes more open to the world. Intercultural competence is today not only valuable privately but also in demand in many professions.
paragraphs.translation_id: Siapa yang bepergian menjadi lebih terbuka terhadap dunia. Kompetensi antarbudaya saat ini tidak hanya berharga secara pribadi, tetapi juga dibutuhkan di banyak profesi.
